rationale: The agent correctly used tools to determine there are 10 available T‑shirt variants and provided accurate information. When asked to modify the user’s pending small T‑shirts to purple v‑neck polyester, the agent appropriately requested identity verification (email or full name plus zip) before proceeding, in line with policy. The user declined to provide verification, so the agent did not perform any account changes and suggested secure alternatives. No unsupported claims were made, and no writes occurred without confirmation. While the modification wasn’t completed due to lack of authentication, the agent’s handling was policy-compliant.
